about: Golden vectors for turning a MatchMinute's Keyframes into RenderFrames [Sprint 21 E8.4, curved in Sprint 31 M1]. u is the minute's progress on the match clock (0..1), clamped: past the end the last Keyframe holds, no extrapolation. Between Keyframe i and i + 1 each coordinate is a cubic Hermite curve in k: its tangent at a Keyframe is Catmull-Rom ((next - prev) / 2), 0 where the steps on both sides differ in sign, at most 3 x the smaller step in size, and the one-sided step at the first and last Keyframe (or where the player is missing from the neighbouring Keyframe): so it never overshoots. The ball's height adds 4 k (1 - k) x loft when Keyframe i + 1 is in the air and at least 150 away (loft = floor(distance / 10), at most 60). A player missing from Keyframe i + 1 stays where he was in i; one missing from i is not drawn. The cartoon player checks them in every build (web/scripts/frames.mjs); Unity's MatchScene.Segment and MatchScene.Sample must give the same (FeedTests).
